Vanessa — thanks for the flag and the attachments. Quick notes from legal triage below. We're splitting workstreams so we can meet the turnaround.

Assigned: Marissa (commercial redlines), Kimberly (security & evidence), me (IP/indemnity / jurisdiction).

Initial risk callouts (will include in redline comments):
- Data & deletion: confirm what "deletion" means for cached logs/KV store — propose a 90-day purge for non-live customer data, and a defined deletion certification on termination.
- IP/Developments: Shoreline wants broader carveouts for derivatives and integrations. We'll propose language clarifying that customer-owned extensions remain customer IP and a narrow Redwood license for support purposes.
- Liability cap: will propose Redwood's standard cap (12 months' fees) and a carveout for willful misconduct. If Shoreline pushes for higher coverage, escalate to VP Sales for approval.
- SLA: need Sean to confirm whether dedicated nodes are required; if yes, SLA and remedy table will be tightened and will include a service credit schedule.
- Security evidence: Kimberly — do we have a sanitized SOC2 Type II shareable link? If not, can we provide the SOC2 assertion PDF + control narratives (non-production PII redacted)?
- Data transfer: customer may request EU data residency language — Alex, please confirm if Shoreline has EU entities or users.

Timing: we'll produce a redline PDF + comment summary by 48 hours (EOB Fri local). If procurement insists on track changes in Word, we can do that too — what format do they prefer? Alex, let us know.

Marissa, Kimberly — please add any other high-risk items in a shared Google Doc and assign owners. I'll draft the legal rationale for each redline so sales can respond to procurement.
